recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any future change to allow multiple ImagingStudy resources to represent different subsets of the same DICOM Study should be handled as a new Imaging Integration decision that explicitly revisits FHIR-47275.
issue_request: FHIR-19559 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for STU3 by Imaging Integration. It requested ImagingStudy Scope wording clarifying that one ImagingStudy references one DICOM Study and may reference a subset of that Study, with more than one ImagingStudy potentially referencing the same DICOM Study or different subsets.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the change was pre-applied on 2018-10-29. Commit 131af0770a (GF#19559) implemented that application in source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-introduction.xml by replacing the prior paragraph with the requested one-DICOM-Study plus subset wording.
additional_context: ImagingStudy and ImagingSelection are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-47275 directly revisited the same boundary because ImagingStudy and ImagingSelection both appeared to allow partial DICOM Study references. Its resolution removed the ImagingStudy subset permission and clarified that ImagingStudy stores details of an entire DICOM Study while ImagingSelection references a subset. Confluence WGM minutes corroborate the FHIR-47275 decision, and commit 41a56bc14a applied it. Later FHIR-54814 preserved the ImagingStudy/ImagingSelection boundary.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source says one ImagingStudy resource SHALL reference one DICOM Study, notes that it can change as more information is added, and says ImagingSelection references subsets of a DICOM Study. Reintroducing the FHIR-19559 subset sentence would conflict with the later FHIR-47275 resolution.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied R6 decision removed the ImagingStudy subset permission and clarified ImagingSelection as the subset mechanism.
Boundaries and Relationships comments were resolved by reference to FHIR-47275.
Later Applied R6 clarification kept the ImagingStudy/ImagingSelection boundary and added the ImagingSelection.derivedFrom explanation.
